say: bo'sun! Sorry, can I say something?

text: Morning, cadet. Quick, I'm busy. What is it?
This grating is cracked. Look, here. The edge is up.
Ah, yes. It's an old crack. It's OK, just walk around it.
Sorry, Bosun, but I don't think it's safe. It's a trip hazard. Someone could fall in the dark.
say: Sorry, bo'sun, but I don't think it's safe. It's a trip hazard. Someone could fall in the dark.

text: Hmm. You're right. At night nobody sees it.
Can we put a barrier and a warning sign?
Good idea. Bring the tape and a sign from the store. I'll stay here.
Here. Barrier tape and the sign.
Good. Now report it to the bridge. Say exactly where it is.
Bridge, Diego. There's a cracked grating on the walkway between tank two and tank three, port side. We put a barrier and a sign. Over.
Received, Diego. Well done. Write a near miss report after the watch. Over.
